min_standing_note.value: Minimum 1 year of undergraduate study required prior to exchange.

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Agreement scope is University-wide (UG, GR). Verify faculty language and prerequisite criteria.

eligible_majors.notes: University-wide exchange; verify departmental capacity in restricted Numerus Clausus faculties (e.g., Human Medicine/Dentistry).

english_course_availability.notes: Features the MIX (Marburg International Exchange) interdisciplinary English-friendly course pool alongside departmental English- and German-taught courses.

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: B2 level (CEFR) strongly recommended or required for English-taught courses; accepted proofs include TOEFL, IELTS, Cambridge certificates, or home university language center confirmations depending on faculty.

host_language_requirement.value: B2 level (CEFR) strongly recommended or required in German for German-taught courses (or B2 English for English-taught courses); optional 4-week preparatory German course before semester start.

fall_term_dates.value: Winter semester Oct 1–Mar 31; Winter 2026/27 lecture period Oct 12, 2026–Feb 12, 2027 (typically mid-Oct to mid-Feb).

spring_term_dates.value: Summer semester Apr 1–Sep 30; Summer 2026 lecture period Apr 13–Jul 17, 2026 (typically mid-Apr to mid-Jul).

tuition_model.notes: Exchange students pay no regular tuition fees and are exempt from the €50 administrative component of the Semesterbeitrag.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Official Marburg finance guide estimate (~€992/month, aligned with German visa/residence-permit blocked account funding requirement).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: 5-month USD estimate from official monthly estimate: €992/month × 5 months = €4,960 × 1.1052 USD/EUR (ECB reference rate ref 2026-11-13, https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/policy_and_exchange_rates/euro_reference_exchange_rates/html/index.en.html, collected 2026-11-15) = $5,482 USD.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Reduced Semesterbeitrag (Winter reference total ~€424.80 minus €50 admin fee exemption for exchange students) covering public transit semester ticket and Studierendenwerk/Mensa services.

housing_availability.notes: Incoming exchange students can reserve a Studierendenwerk dorm room directly within the online exchange application.

housing_notes.value: Studierendenwerk Marburg dormitory room reservation option is integrated into the Mobility-Online exchange application.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-EU students requiring a German visa or residence permit must show financial solvency aligned with the ~€992/month living-expense/blocked-account benchmark.

exchange_page_url.notes: Excel Col H Google Drive fact sheet (14qPKAp8yXdkNupWq_iJBd86TmL0sItPF) returned unreachable HTML payload; official overseas exchange portal used instead.

course_catalog_url.notes: MARVIN central campus portal hosts the official course catalog, MIX modules, and course/exam registration.

course_restrictions_note.value: Human Medicine (Humanmedizin) and Dentistry carry Numerus Clausus (NC) admission restrictions per degree-program rules; confirm non-degree exchange access with host coordinator.

academic_style.value: Comprehensive German public university using MARVIN for module/exam registration, including the MIX (Marburg International Exchange) interdisciplinary course pool.

international_support_services.value: Orientation program and optional 4-week preparatory German language course offered prior to semester start.

nomination_deadlines.value: Winter semester application deadline July 10; Summer semester application deadline January 10 (via Mobility-Online following home university nomination).
